Internal helper: a chart made a figure

Source: R/tables.R
dot-jst_figure_build.Rd

The frame's facts, read once, when the figure is made (rulings R63, R69, R71): the style it is framed in – the call's style =; else, for a chart jplot() drew, the style it was drawn in, so the Word file shows what the Plots pane showed; else the session's – its title, N after it (the chart's analysis N; the S412 audit's F7), the general note (N where n.position puts it, the filter the chart was drawn under, the call's note) and the call's source. A chart drawn in ggplot2 by hand has no N, no filter and no data sheet; its look stays its own.

Usage

.jst_figure_build(p, style = NULL, title = NULL, note = NULL, source = NULL)

Arguments

p

The chart.

style

The call's style, resolved, or NULL.

title, note, source

As jtable()'s.

Value

An object of class "jst_figure".

Details

The title: the call's title =; else the title in the chart's picture (a result plot's own, "Residuals vs Fitted", or one added with + labs(title = )), which moves to the caption; else jplot()'s default from labels (ruling R69); else none.
